policy: Every record below was fetched in this session. Quotes are verbatim from the retrieved document. Provider-published tariffs are labelled type=commercial.

sources.title: Administrative Rules on Individual's Foreign Exchange (PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3)
sources.quote: Art. 7: 'Commercial banks and individuals ... must not evade limit administration by splitting large amount into small batches or tamper with authenticity administration by using fabricated commercial bills or vouchers.' Art. 9: 'An individual's foreign exchange sales and domestic individual's foreign exchange purchases shall be imposed an annual limit. Within the annual limit, an individual can conduct a sale or purchase business with a bank by presenting valid identity documents; beyond the annual limit, an individual can conduct a current account business with a commercial bank by presenting valid identity documents and relevant materials proving the transaction amount while a capital account business shall be conducted according to relevant provisions in Chapter Three.' Art. 12: 'An individual can transfer foreign exchange abroad to support current account payment at a bank by showing valid identity documents when a single transaction or accumulative amount within a single business day is below the stipulated limit; he/she can conduct the business at a bank by showing valid identity documents and relevant documents proving the transaction amount when ... above the stipulated limit.' Art. 13: 'A non-domestic individual can convert legitimate renminbi income obtained in China under the current account into foreign exchange and remit abroad at a bank by showing valid identity documents and relevant documents.' Art. 15: 'A non-domestic individual can convert unused purchased renminbi back into foreign currency cash in a small amount at a bank or a foreign currency exchange agency by showing valid identity documents; he/she needs to present the original exchange invoice when the amount is above the stipulated limit.' Art. 16: 'Where an outward direct investment intended by a domestic individual is consistent with relevant regulations, the domestic individual can remit abroad purchased or own foreign exchange after verification by the SAFE...' Art. 20: 'A domestic individual can purchase foreign exchange for the purpose of overseas donation and wealth transfer when such purchase is consistent with relevant regulations and verified by the SAFE.'
sources.notes: Effective 1 February 2007. Defines the annual-limit architecture and the split prohibition (Art. 7).

sources.authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), Tianjin branch mirror of national text
sources.title: Detailed Rules for the Implementation of the Measures for the Administration of Individual Foreign Exchange (Hui Fa [2007] No. 1, as amended)
sources.quote: Art. 2: '对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。' (Annual total management for individual settlement and domestic individuals' FX purchase: the annual totals are each person per year the equivalent of USD 50,000.) '个人年度总额内的结汇和购汇，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过年度总额的，经常项目项下按本细则第十条、第十一条、第十二条办理，资本项目项下按本细则资本项目个人外汇管理有关规定办理。' Art. 3: '个人所购外汇，可以汇出境外、存入本人外汇储蓄账户，或按照有关规定携带出境。' (Purchased FX may be remitted abroad, deposited in the individual's FX savings account, or carried out of the country per rules.) Art. 12: '境内个人经常项目项下非经营性购汇超过年度总额的，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料在银行办理。' (Domestic individuals' non-operating FX purchase over the annual total: valid ID plus proof materials showing a transaction amount at the bank.) Art. 14: '境内个人外汇汇出境外用于经常项目支出……外汇储蓄账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过上述金额的，凭经常项目项下有交易额的真实性凭证办理。手持外币现钞汇出当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理；超过上述金额的，凭经常项目项下有交易额的真实性凭证、经海关签章的《中华人民共和国海关进境旅客行李物品申报单》或本人原存款银行外币现钞提取单据办理。' (Domestic individual remitting FX abroad for current-account expenditure: from an FX savings account, day-cumulative up to USD 50,000 equivalent with valid ID; above that, authenticity documents showing the transaction amount. Hand-carried FX cash: day-cumulative up to USD 10,000 equivalent with valid ID; above, such documents plus a customs-stamped declaration form or the original bank cash-withdrawal slip.) Art. 13(2): '原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。' Art. 20: '移居境外的境内个人将其取得合法移民身份前境内财产对外转移以及外国公民依法继承境内遗产的对外转移，按《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》等有关规定办理。' Art. 30: '个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下（含）的，可以在银行直接办理；超过上述金额的……向银行所在地外汇局事前报备。' Art. 31: '个人向外汇储蓄账户存入外币现钞，当日累计等值5000美元以下（含）的，可以在银行直接办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、经海关签章的……申报单……办理。'
sources.notes: Mirror page dated 2024-04-30 shows the consolidated amended text. Page footnote: Art. 9(2) amended by Hui Fa [2016] No. 13; Art. 39 (RMB 30k/1k fine provision) REPEALED by Hui Fa [2023] No. 8. Penalty enforcement therefore runs through the Regulations on Foreign Exchange Administration (Decree 532, source P03).

sources.title: SAFE Spokesman press conference on the Detailed Rules for individual FX (annual quota rationale)
sources.quote: 'The Detailed Rules specify that the annual quota for individual foreign exchange purchases be drastically raised from USD 20,000 to USD 50,000 ... The annual quota of USD 50,000 for individual foreign exchange sales will basically satisfy the normal demands for individual foreign exchange sales ...' 'In cases where an individual withdraws foreign cash with a cumulative daily amount or an equivalent exceeding USD 10,000, he/she shall file related documents in advance with the SAFE; in cases where an individual carries foreign cash abroad with a cumulative daily amount in excess of an amount equivalent to USD 10,000, he/she shall additionally provide relevant declaration forms signed and sealed by the customs or his bank forms for the withdrawal of the foreign cash from the original deposit bank.'
sources.notes: English SAFE page; confirms USD 50,000 annual quota for both sales and purchases and cash-carry/withdrawal documentation thresholds.

sources.authority: State Council of the PRC (published by SAFE)
sources.title: Regulations of the PRC on Foreign Exchange Administration (State Council Decree No. 532)
sources.quote: Art. 5: '国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。' (The State does not restrict current international payments and transfers.) Art. 12: '经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础。' Art. 17: '境内机构、境内个人向境外直接投资或者从事境外有价证券、衍生产品发行交易，应当按照国务院外汇管理部门的规定办理登记。' Art. 39: '有违反规定将境内外汇转移境外……等逃汇行为的……处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。' Art. 40: '……骗购外汇等非法套汇行为的……处非法套汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处非法套汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款……' Art. 42: '违反规定携带外汇出入境的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。' Art. 44: '违反规定，擅自改变外汇或者结汇资金用途的……没收违法所得，处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。' Art. 45: '私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的……没收违法所得，处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。' Art. 48: '……对机构可以处30万元以下的罚款，对个人可以处5万元以下的罚款：（一）未按照规定进行国际收支统计申报的……（三）未按照规定提交有效单证或者提交的单证不真实的……' Art. 52(2): '境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人……' (Domestic individual means Chinese citizens and foreigners who have resided continuously in China for one year or more, excluding PRC diplomatic personnel and representatives of international organizations.)
sources.notes: Effective 5 August 2008. This is the operative penalty regime after Hui Fa [2007] No. 1 Art. 39 was repealed by Hui Fa [2023] No. 8. Art. 52(2) makes the domestic/non-domestic classification residence-dependent for a foreign national — material to whether the USD 50,000 annual purchase facility applies to them as a 'domestic individual' if resident >=1 year.

sources.title: Notice on Regulating Large Cash Withdrawals Abroad with Bank Cards (Hui Fa [2017] No. 29)
sources.quote: Item 1: '个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。超过年度额度的，本年及次年将被暂停持境内银行卡在境外提取现金。个人不得通过借用他人银行卡或出借本人银行卡等方式规避或协助规避境外提取现金管理。' (Overseas cash withdrawal with domestic bank cards: combined cards in the individual's own name may not exceed RMB 100,000 equivalent per calendar year; exceeding suspends withdrawals for that year and the next. Borrowing or lending cards to evade is prohibited.) Item 4: '外币卡由每卡每日不得超过等值1000美元调整为等值1万元人民币……人民币卡管理维持每卡每日不得超过等值1万元人民币……' (Foreign-currency card: per card per day cap set at RMB 10,000 equivalent; RMB card: per card per day cap RMB 10,000 equivalent.) Item 7: '本通知自2018年1月1日起实施。'
sources.notes: Overseas ATM cash route hard-capped: RMB 100,000/year and RMB 10,000/day/card.

sources.authority: People's Bank of China (announced via SAFE)
sources.title: Provisional Measures for the Administration of Sale and Payment of Foreign Exchange for Individuals' Outward Asset Transfers (PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16, full text)
sources.quote: Art. 2: '移民转移是指从中国内地移居外国，或者赴香港、澳门特别行政区定居的自然人……将其在取得移民身份之前在境内拥有的合法财产变现，通过外汇指定银行购汇和汇出境外的行为。' (Emigration transfer: a natural person emigrating from mainland China to a foreign country or settling in HK/Macau converts lawful domestic property owned BEFORE obtaining immigration status into FX through a designated bank and remits it abroad.) Art. 6: '移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出。首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满一年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半；自首次汇出满两年后，可汇出全部剩余财产。全部申请转移财产在等值人民币20万元以下（含20万元）的，经批准后可一次性汇出。' (Emigration transfer: apply once for the full amount; first remittance may not exceed one-half; after one year, up to one-half of the remainder; after two years, the entire remainder. At or under RMB 200,000: single remittance after approval.) Art. 8 materials include: '（四）移居外国的，应当提供公安机关出具的中国户籍注销证明和中国驻外使领馆出具或认证的申请人在国外定居证明……（六）申请转移财产所在地或收入来源地主管税务机关开具的税收证明或完税凭证。' (Household-registration cancellation certificate + proof of settlement abroad; tax certificate or tax-payment voucher from the competent tax authority.) Art. 10: '申请财产对外转移总金额在等值人民币50万元以下（含50万元）的，由所在地外汇局审批。……超过上述金额的，由所在地外汇局初审后，报国家外汇管理局审批。' (At or under RMB 500,000: local SAFE branch approves; above: branch preliminary review then SAFE head-office approval.) Art. 11: '外汇指定银行办理售汇后，应直接将外汇汇往……申请人本人的账户，不得在境内提取外币现钞。' Art. 13: fraud → '外汇局按照《中华人民共和国外汇管理条例》第四十条的规定给予处罚。' Art. 16: '本办法自2004年12月1日起施行。'
sources.notes: The lawful bulk-emigration route. Requires household-registration cancellation, so it is unavailable to someone who still lives in China. Approval is per-case; amounts and staging are fixed by the measure.

sources.authority: SAFE and General Administration of Customs (GACC)
sources.title: Provisional Measures on Carrying Foreign Currency Cash Across the Border (Hui Fa [2003] No. 102)
sources.quote: '出境人员携带不超过等值5000美元（含5000美元）的外币现钞出境的，无须申领《携带证》，海关予以放行；出境人员携带外币现钞金额在等值5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，应向外汇指定银行申领《携带证》，海关凭加盖外汇指定银行印章的《携带证》验放；出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元的外币现钞出境……' (Carrying FX cash out: up to USD 5,000 equivalent — no permit, customs releases; USD 5,000-10,000 — carrying permit from a designated bank required; in principle may not carry more than USD 10,000, except listed special cases approved by SAFE.) '出境人员可以携带外币现钞出境，也可以按国家金融管理规定通过从银行汇出或携带汇票、旅行支票、国际信用卡等方式将外币携出境外。'
sources.notes: Sets the physical cash-carrying ceilings out of China; pairs with CBP's USD 10,000 US-side declaration (US source U03).

sources.title: 2024 current-account FX policy Q&A case (9): Do non-domestic individuals enjoy the annual facilitation quota for FX purchase?
sources.quote: '根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条，境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。' (Non-domestic individuals purchasing FX with lawful RMB current-account income handle it at the bank with valid ID and source-of-funds materials showing a transaction amount, including tax vouchers. Non-domestic individuals holding a Foreign Permanent Resident ID card are subject to the annual facilitation quota for FX purchase.)
sources.notes: Establishes that among non-domestic individuals, only Permanent-Resident-ID holders get the USD 50,000 convenience quota; others need source-of-funds documents with tax vouchers.

sources.title: 2026 individual FX Q&A (10): Can a non-domestic individual convert previously exchanged, unused RMB back to FX?
sources.quote: '境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。' citing 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》汇发〔2020〕14号 第六十条 (Current Account FX Business Guidelines 2020, Art. 60).
sources.notes: The USD 500/1,000 exception is narrow: it applies only to reconversion of a NON-DOMESTIC individual's previously exchanged, unused RMB, with the original exchange receipt (24-month validity). It is not a general quota bypass.

sources.authority: SAFE and GACC (via SAFE news release with full text)
sources.title: PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16 — see P06 for the same measure; here recorded as the SAFE news publication confirming issuance
sources.quote: '《暂行办法》规定，对超过20万元（含20万元）人民币的移民财产转移采取一次申请、分步汇出……自2004年12月1日起正式实施。' (For emigration property transfers of RMB 200,000 or more: one application, staged remittance; measure effective 1 December 2004.)
sources.notes: Same document as P06; retained as a separate retrieval record of the SAFE news publication page. Redundant to P06 — used only as corroboration of the issuance date.

sources.title: Account and Service Tariff, Personal Customers (effective 1 January 2021)
sources.quote: Title page: '账户和服务费率 个人客户适用（2021年1月1日生效）' (Account and service tariff, applicable to personal customers, effective 1 January 2021). Item 5.1.1.1 outward telegraphic transfer: '按汇款金额的0.1%收取 每笔最低人民币100元/等值 每笔最高人民币500元/等值 另加电报费' (0.1% of the remittance amount, min CNY 100, max CNY 500, plus cable fee). Item 5.1.1.2 cable fee: '每笔人民币120元/等值'. Note to 5.1.1.x: '如汇款人要求美元汇出汇款全额划付收款人，我行将预先向汇款人收取人民币200元/等值作为预扣海外代理行费用……不足部分再根据海外代理行的通知另行收取。' (If the remitter requires the USD remittance to be credited in full to the beneficiary, the bank pre-collects CNY 200 equivalent as an estimated overseas intermediary-bank charge; shortfalls are charged later per the intermediary's advice.) Item 5.1.1.4 '外币现钞转兑现汇': Premier free; other account types '按外币金额的1%收取' (1% of the FX amount). Item 2.12 '由外币现钞账户转帐至现汇账户': Premier free; others 1%. Item 3.1.1 FX cash withdrawal at counter: Premier/其他 free; personal comprehensive account '按取款金额的0.25%-0.4%收取 每笔最低人民币40元/等值'. Item 5.1.1.1 note 2: HSBC Premier customers remitting online between same-name HSBC accounts across borders: local fee waived. Item 5.3.3 study remittance: Premier free; reference price CNY 50 per transaction (actual price USD 7 or equivalent). Item 5.4.1.2 incoming pass-through: 0.125%, min CNY 200, max CNY 600, plus cable. Item 6.1.2.1 domestic FX TT: 0.1% min CNY 100 max CNY 500 plus CNY 120 cable (6.1.2.2).
sources.notes: PRIMARY PROVIDER TARIFF (commercial, labelled as such). Published by the bank itself; effective date 1 January 2021 per the document. Tariff does not publish a CNY/USD conversion spread. Other institutions' fees are not covered by this tariff.

sources.title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
sources.locator: Who must file / When to file / Penalties
sources.quote: 'A U.S. person, including a citizen ... must file an FBAR to report: 1. a financial interest in or signature or other authority over at least one financial account located outside the United States if 2. the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported.' 'The FBAR is an annual report, due April 15 following the calendar year reported. You're allowed an automatic extension to October 15...' 'You must file the FBAR electronically through FinCEN's BSA E-Filing System.' 'You may be subject to civil monetary penalties and/or criminal penalties for FBAR reporting and/or recordkeeping violations. Assertion of penalties depends on facts and circumstances. Civil FBAR penalty maximums in Title 31 of the United States Code are adjusted annually for inflation.'
sources.notes: The China bank account(s) of a U.S. citizen are reportable if aggregate > USD 10,000 at any time, whether or not taxable income was produced.

sources.title: Do I need to file Form 8938, Statement of Specified Foreign Financial Assets?
sources.quote: 'Unmarried taxpayers living in the US: The total value of your specified foreign financial assets is more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year or more than $75,000 at any time during the tax year' · 'Married taxpayers filing a joint income tax return and living in the US: ... more than $100,000 on the last day ... or more than $150,000 at any time' · 'Married taxpayers filing separate income tax returns and living in the US: ... more than $50,000 ... or more than $75,000' · taxpayers living abroad (non-joint): 'more than $200,000 on the last day ... or more than $300,000 at any time'; abroad joint: 'more than $400,000 ... or more than $600,000'.
sources.notes: Form 8938 attaches to the income tax return; different thresholds by filing status and abroad/domestic.

sources.title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
sources.locator: Federal Mandate section / Who Must File / What if I don't file
sources.quote: 'Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP).' 'Anyone who brings, sends, or receives currency or monetary instruments totaling more than $10,000 at one time, either into or out of the United States, must report it.' 'When families or groups are involved, the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual.' 'An Individual who fails to file a report or submit false or fraudulent information, risk having their currency or monetary instruments forfeited and seized. In some instances, they may face civil or criminal penalties such as fines or imprisonment. See 31 U.S.C.5321 and 31 CFR 1010.820...' Filing via FinCEN Form 105 (fincen105.cbp.dhs.gov). Page last modified Nov 24, 2025.
sources.notes: US-side cash/monetary-instrument declaration threshold for physical carriage or shipping of currency.

sources.authority: FinCEN / eCFR (Office of the Federal Register)
sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table
sources.quote: 'Displaying title 31, up to date as of 11/05/2026.' Table 1, row 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) 'Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction': penalties as last amended by statute '$10,000'; 'Maximum penalty amounts or range ... for penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025' = '$16,536'. Row 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) 'Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Willful Violation of Transaction': statute '$100,000'; adjusted = '$165,353'. Row 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(1) general BSA willful: statute '$25,000-$100,000'; adjusted '$71,545-$286,184'.
sources.notes: Current inflation-adjusted FBAR civil penalty maxima per violation. The statute itself (31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)) governs how the penalty base is computed; eCFR replaces the statutory dollar amounts with the adjusted figures.

sources.authority: U.S. Government Publishing Office (govinfo) — U.S. Code, 2024 Edition
sources.title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
sources.quote: (a)(1)(A): 'any foreign currency gain or loss attributable to a section 988 transaction shall be computed separately and treated as ordinary income or loss'. (c)(1)(C)(i): 'In the case of any disposition of any nonfunctional currency — (I) such disposition shall be treated as a section 988 transaction...'. (c)(1)(C)(ii): 'nonfunctional currency includes coin or currency, and nonfunctional currency denominated demand or time deposits or similar instruments issued by a bank or other financial institution.' (e)(1): 'The preceding provisions of this section shall not apply to any section 988 transaction entered into by an individual which is a personal transaction.' (e)(2): 'If — (A) nonfunctional currency is disposed of by an individual in any transaction, and (B) such transaction is a personal transaction, no gain shall be recognized ... by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired by such individual and before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.' (e)(3): 'personal transaction means any transaction entered into by an individual, except that such term shall not include any transaction to the extent that expenses properly allocable to such transaction meet the requirements of — (A) section 162 ... or (B) section 212 ...'.
sources.notes: 2024 Code edition (dated edition caveat applies). The $200 personal-transaction exclusion is per the statute text; whether an individual's conversion is 'personal' rather than expense-related is a facts-and-circumstances determination.

sources.authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) / National People's Congress
sources.title: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC (2018 revision, seventh amendment)
sources.quote: Art. 1: '在中国境内有住所，或者无住所而一个纳税年度内在中国境内居住累计满一百八十三天的个人，为居民个人。居民个人从中国境内和境外取得的所得，依照本法规定缴纳个人所得税。' Art. 2 lists nine taxable income categories: '（一）工资、薪金所得；（二）劳务报酬所得；（三）稿酬所得；（四）特许权使用费所得；（五）经营所得；（六）利息、股息、红利所得；（七）财产租赁所得；（八）财产转让所得；（九）偶然所得。' Art. 3: '综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率……经营所得，适用百分之五至百分之三十五的超额累进税率……利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。' Art. 6(5): '财产转让所得，以转让财产的收入额减除财产原值和合理费用后的余额，为应纳税所得额。' Art. 7: '居民个人从中国境外取得的所得，可以从其应纳税额中抵免已在境外缴纳的个人所得税税额，但抵免额不得超过该纳税人境外所得依照本法规定计算的应纳税额。' Art. 10: filing required including '（四）取得境外所得' and '（五）因移居境外注销中国户籍'. Art. 13: '纳税人因移居境外注销中国户籍的，应当在注销中国户籍前办理税款清算。' Art. 16: '各项所得的计算，以人民币为单位。所得为人民币以外的货币的，按照人民币汇率中间价折合成人民币缴纳税款。'
sources.notes: The nine enumerated categories do not include a tax on the act of converting one's own currency holdings; tax attaches to the listed income types (e.g., 20% on interest/dividends and property transfers, on net amounts). Whether a given receipt is income within these categories is a facts-and-circumstances question — no personal tax figure is asserted here.

sources.authority: PBOC and seven other PRC departments (PBOC, NDRC, MIIT, MPS, SAMR, NFRA, CSRC, SAFE)
sources.title: Notice on Further Preventing and Handling Risks Related to Virtual Currency (Yin Fa [2026] No. 42)
sources.quote: '虚拟货币不具有与法定货币等同的法律地位……不应且不能作为货币在市场上流通使用。虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务、虚拟货币之间的兑换业务、作为中央对手方买卖虚拟货币、为虚拟货币交易提供信息中介和定价服务、代币发行融资以及虚拟货币相关金融产品交易等虚拟货币相关业务活动……一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。境外单位和个人不得以任何形式非法向境内主体提供虚拟货币相关服务。' '任何单位和个人投资虚拟货币、现实世界资产代币及相关金融产品，违背公序良俗的，相关民事法律行为无效，由此引发的损失由其自行承担；涉嫌破坏金融秩序、危害金融安全的，由相关部门依法查处。' '本通知自发布之日起施行。中国人民银行等十部门《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。' Dated 2026-02-06.
sources.notes: Current PRC rule (published 6 Feb 2026). Expressly repeals Yin Fa [2021] No. 237. Virtual-currency conversion channels are prohibited financial activities — published here as a rejected route.

sources.title: 2026 individual FX Q&A (08): How do non-domestic individuals convert and remit labor income earned while working in China?
sources.quote: '境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇' citing 《经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条 (Current Account FX Business Guidelines 2020, Art. 59).
sources.notes: Labor income route: FX purchase and remittance requires valid ID plus source-of-funds materials with a transaction amount, including tax vouchers.

sources.title: Foreign Tax Credit (individuals)
sources.locator: intro / How to claim / Compliance issues
sources.quote: 'If you paid or accrued foreign taxes to a foreign country or U.S. possession and are subject to U.S. tax on the same income, you may be able to take either a credit or an itemized deduction for those taxes.' 'Taken as a credit, foreign income taxes reduce your U.S. tax liability. In most cases, it is to your advantage to take foreign income taxes as a tax credit.' 'File Form 1116, Foreign Tax Credit (Individual, Estate, or Trust), to claim the foreign tax credit...' 'A foreign tax credit may not be claimed for taxes on income that you exclude from U.S. gross income, for example, the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion.' 'If you are entitled to a reduced rate of foreign tax based on an income tax treaty between the United States and a foreign country, only that reduced tax qualifies for the credit.'
sources.notes: Credit mechanism for PRC tax on the same income; cannot offset US tax on excluded FEI; treaty-reduced rates limit the creditable amount.

sources.authority: US Treasury / IRS (treaty text as transmitted to the Senate)
sources.title: United States–People's Republic of China Income Tax Convention (signed 30 April 1984; Second Protocol 10 May 1986; in force 1 January 1987)
sources.locator: Arts. 9, 10, 11; transmittal letter; table of articles (Saving Clause reference)
sources.quote: Art. 9(2): 'such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the laws of that Contracting State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the dividends.' Art. 10(2): interest 'shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the interest.' Art. 11(2): royalties 'shall not exceed 10 percent of the gross amount of the royalties.' Transmittal letter: 'the agreement limits the tax which each country may impose on dividends, interest and royalties derived by residents of the other country to no more than 10 percent in each case.' Table of articles lists: 'The 'Saving Clause' Paragraph 2 of the Protocol 1 of 30 April, 1984'.
sources.notes: Entered into force 1 January 1987. The Protocol 1 saving clause is listed in the document; its exact text was not separately extracted in this session — flagged for expert confirmation rather than quoted. No personal tax rate is computed here.

sources.authority: SAFE (data from China Foreign Exchange Trade System)
sources.title: RMB central parity rates (人民币汇率中间价)
sources.quote: Table row '2026-11-09 | 美元 671.88 | ...'. Notes: '数据来源于中国外汇交易中心。' '人民币对其它10种货币汇率中间价仍采取直接标价法，即100外币折合多少人民币。' (USD is direct-quoted: 100 USD = 671.88 CNY, i.e., 1 USD = 6.7188 CNY on 2026-11-09.)
sources.notes: Official SAFE-published central parity used as the single conversion anchor for translating published CNY fee caps into USD in this session's cost model. A central parity is not a customer's executable retail rate; the customer spread remains unpublished and is left blank/flagged.

sources.title: 2018 individual FX administration Q&A (4): What should domestic individuals pay attention to when purchasing FX?
sources.quote: '境内个人办理购汇业务时，应如实填写《个人购汇申请书》，不得虚假申报个人购汇信息；不得提供不实的证明材料；不得出借本人便利化额度协助他人购汇；不得借用他人便利化额度实施分拆购汇；不得用于境外买房、证券投资、购买人寿保险和投资返还分红类保险等资本未开放的资本项目；不得参与洗钱、逃税、地下钱庄交易等违法违规活动。' (Domestic individuals buying FX must truthfully complete the FX Purchase Application; must not falsely declare information; must not provide untrue supporting materials; must not lend their facilitation quota to assist others; must not borrow others' quotas to conduct split purchases; must not use the FX for overseas real-estate purchase, securities investment, life insurance and investment-linked dividend insurance or other unopened capital items; must not participate in money laundering, tax evasion, underground-banking transactions or other illegal activities.)
sources.notes: The 'six don'ts' — the official statement of prohibited purposes and prohibited quota-abuse methods for domestic individuals. Source of the rejected-route entries R05 (quota lending/splitting), R06 (underground banking), R07 (prohibited declared purposes).

sources.title: U.S. citizens and resident aliens abroad
sources.locator: opening paragraphs; FBAR and Form 3520 bullets
sources.quote: 'You are subject to tax on worldwide income from all sources and must report all taxable income and pay taxes according to the Internal Revenue Code.' 'U.S. taxpayers who own or have an interest in certain foreign financial accounts in excess of the reporting threshold must report those accounts to the U.S. Treasury Department, even if the accounts don't generate any taxable income.' 'Receipt of more than $100,000 in gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien individual or foreign estate (including foreign persons related to that nonresident alien individual or foreign estate)' is reportable on Form 3520. 'Taxpayers must also report virtual currency transactions to the IRS on their tax returns; these transactions are taxable by law just like any other property transaction.'
sources.notes: Establishes US worldwide-income taxation of citizens, the Form 3520 >$100,000 foreign-gift threshold from an official IRS page (resolves the earlier sessions' unverified 3520 threshold flag for this session's own content), and digital-asset reporting.

sources.authority: U.S. Government Publishing Office (govinfo) — U.S. Code, 2023 Edition
sources.title: 31 U.S.C. § 5321 — Civil penalties
sources.quote: (a)(5)(B)(i): 'the amount of any civil penalty imposed under subparagraph (A) shall not exceed $10,000.' (a)(5)(B)(ii): 'No penalty shall be imposed ... if — (I) such violation was due to reasonable cause, and (II) the amount of the transaction or the balance in the account at the time of the transaction was properly reported.' (a)(5)(C): 'In the case of any person willfully violating ... (i) the maximum penalty under subparagraph (B)(i) shall be increased to the greater of — (I) $100,000, or (II) 50 percent of the amount determined under subparagraph (D), and (ii) subparagraph (B)(ii) shall not apply.' (a)(5)(D)(ii): for account non-reporting, the amount is 'the balance in the account at the time of the violation.' (a)(4)(B): structuring-violation civil penalty 'shall not exceed the amount of the coins and currency ... involved in the transaction'. (b)(1): assessment 'at any time before the end of the 6-year period beginning on the date of the transaction'.
sources.notes: Statutory FBAR penalty structure. The inflation-adjusted dollar maxima are in 31 CFR 1010.821 (U04). 2023 Code edition — edition-date caveat applies.

sources.title: United States–PRC Income Tax Convention — Protocol 1 (saving clause), text as transmitted
sources.quote: 'Notwithstanding any provision of the Agreement, the United States may tax its citizens. Except as provided in paragraph 2 of Article 8, paragraph 2 of Article 17, and Articles 18, 19, 20, 22, 23, 24 and 26 of this Agreement, the United States may tax its residents (as determined under Article 4).'
sources.notes: The saving clause: the treaty does not limit US taxation of US citizens. Retrieved from the same IRS treaty PDF as U07; recorded separately because the exact protocol text was extracted in a later chunk.

sources.title: Wise Help Centre: Guide to CNY transfers
sources.quote: 'When sending CNY from China: you can set up a bank transfer from your Chinese bank account or send from your Alipay app. Regulatory requirements apply when you are using this product. Wise is collaborating with a licensed third party payment provider (regulated by the People's Bank of China) in China to provide this service.' 'You can send money from CNY if: You're not mainland Chinese ... You're working or have worked in China before; You have a valid tax record issued by the China tax authority showing taxes paid within the last 3 years.' 'Due to regulations, you can only send CNY from China to another account you own. This can be your bank account outside of China, or your Wise Account.' 'If you're sending CNY from your China bank app, the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY. Alipay: ... 50,000 CNY.' 'Wise also adheres to China's regulations and applies a limit on how much you can send out of China. This is known as overall limit and it's calculated based on: Your annual income; The amount of tax you have paid in China; The number of years you've paid taxes on, proven through tax record(s) submitted. In general, your overall limit is the amount of salary you've earned in China after deducting the amount of tax paid in China.' 'The fees for transfers to CNY differ based on the delivery method ... Set up a transfer and add a recipient to see the exact fees for your transaction.'
sources.notes: COMMERCIAL source (labelled). Wise does not publish the from-CNY fee on this page — fee cells for this route stay blank/flagged. Eligibility is tax-record based and restricted to own-account transfers.
